common_gotchas: Requires a valid Point File In TOP; this node does not load files by itself.
Channel selections should match attributes available in the source point file.
Still emits only RGBA per output, so multiple Select TOPs may be needed for many fields.
Treat output as point data texture unless it is explicitly mapped for display.
key_concepts: Creates additional output images from a Point File In TOP source.
Intended for point files with more than four channels or attributes.
Avoids loading the same point source again when multiple RGBA field groupings are needed.
Channel choices must match fields available in the source point data or official constant channels.
